name: oncology-hackathon-munich
description: Oncology Hackathon 2026 Munich starter – root scripts for backend (uv) and frontend (npm workspace).

scripts.setup: cd backend && uv sync && cd .. && npm install
scripts.dev:api: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.lint: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && cd .. && npm run lint --workspace frontend
scripts.format: cd backend && uv run ruff format . && uv run ruff check --fix .
